column2: A woman slides one extra blue chair up to a round dining table where three yellow chairs are already occupied.
A boy deliberately sticks out his foot to trip a classmate carrying a carefully finished clay pot, grinning at the harm.
A painter has just placed the first short brushstroke on an otherwise blank canvas, with the loaded brush still touching it.
An open tin holds thick black shoe polish beside a stiff brush and one partly polished black leather boot.
A wrapped loaf of bread passes from a shopkeeper into a customer's shopping bag across a bakery counter.
A gray lead came joins two colored stained-glass panes, with its channel-shaped edge clearly cradling the glass.
A closed takeaway carton holds noodles beside chopsticks, a folded paper bag and a sealed cup on a small counter.
A boy lowers an empty drinking glass and wipes his wet lips beside a pitcher of water.
A plate holds only cake crumbs and a used fork, while a satisfied diner finishes swallowing the last mouthful.
One child mischievously urges another toward a muddy puddle, pointing eagerly while the hesitant child raises one foot.
A soft animal pelt lies fur-side upward over a low wooden stool, with its supple leather underside folded into view.
A small rounded grassy hill rises above a winding footpath, with a walker near its base showing its modest height.
A substitute goalkeeper pulls on spare gloves while an injured teammate hands over the team jersey beside the goal.
A swallow flies low over a pond with both wings spread and its forked tail streaming behind it.
A traveler reaches an empty pocket beside an unlocked front door, while the forgotten house key rests on an indoor table.
A worker kneads thick wet woolen cloth in a wooden tub, pressing and rubbing the fibers together during fulling.
A parent gives a sleepy child a gentle farewell wave beside a bed, with a crescent moon visible through the window.
A child proudly holds a newly received wooden toy while the smiling giver lowers an empty hand toward the open gift box.
A drenched traveler stands beside a bicycle with a flat tire as cold rain soaks a torn shopping bag.
A homing pigeon flies toward the open entrance of its familiar wooden loft, where another pigeon waits inside.
A colorful horse cloth drapes over a saddled horse's back and flanks, its fabric edges hanging clearly below the saddle.
A child steps through the open entrance of a small tent, with one foot and both hands already inside.
A woman reads an open book attentively and writes neatly in a notebook beside it, using simple indistinct page marks only.
A child cups one hand behind an ear and listens closely to a nearby violinist drawing a bow across the strings.
A child gazes longingly at a ripe peach behind a shop window, hands clasped against the chest.
A cow stretches its neck and opens its mouth in a deep lowing call while a calf stands beside it.
A teenage girl in everyday clothes carries a basket through a garden, shown as an ordinary young person without name labels.
A baker holds an ordinary medium-sized loaf at a busy bakery counter, surrounded by the same unremarkable everyday loaves.
A small open glass container holds brown musk granules beside a tiny perfume vial and a narrow wooden scoop.
A plane tree has a broad trunk, peeling mottled bark, large lobed leaves and several round hanging seed balls.
A person straightens a smart waistcoat and jacket in a mirror, with a matching hat waiting on the dressing table.
A small bell swings after a child pulls its cord, with the clapper visibly touching the inside of the bell.
Two former rival captains clasp hands again across a table, joining their red and blue shield emblems side by side.
A traveler with a small suitcase steps back into a welcoming house as family members greet them at the open doorway.
A rider swings one leg down from a saddled horse after a ride, with muddy hoofprints leading to the resting place.
The sun has risen just above a low hill, lighting the rooftops and casting long early-morning shadows.
A stout anchor rode connects a small boat's bow to its anchor on the seabed, visible through clear shallow water.
A weekly calendar has seven picture-only day cells: five small work-bag icons, then a brightly highlighted kite day and a resting day.
An elder offers thoughtful advice to a listening child while pointing to a steadily walking tortoise passing a resting hare nearby.
A potter smooths the rim of a clay bowl that has taken its finished rounded shape on the wheel.
Exactly six drink cans stand in two rows of three inside a plain cardboard carrier, with all six can tops visible.
A runner speeds across a path with long strides, a scarf streaming backward and small puffs of dust behind the shoes.
A jack-in-the-box has sprung upward on its extended coil, with the open lid and a startled child's hands nearby.
A singer finishes a song while holding a microphone toward an applauding audience, one hand resting over the heart.
A baseball lands in a waiting glove while the thrower's arm remains extended in its completed follow-through.
Two hands hold the separated halves of a freshly torn sheet of colored paper, showing matching ragged edges.
A builder tests a stout rope by suspending a heavy sandbag from it, watching the secure knot hold firmly.
A small sailboat heads toward the low setting sun over a calm sea, its bow pointing into the warm western glow.
A furious man crumples papers beside an overturned chair, with a tense face and disordered desk showing uncontrolled agitation.
A small airport terminal stands beside a runway where one passenger plane taxis and a traveler carries a suitcase toward the entrance.
A square garden plot measures ten meters along each side, with two measuring tapes showing only the essential markings “10 m”.
A child blows gently through a bubble wand, cheeks puffed as several round soap bubbles emerge from the ring.
A flowering branch carries one opening blossom whose petals unfold around the center, with tightly closed buds on the same stem.
A short cylindrical metal bushing fits closely inside a larger machine housing, guiding a smooth shaft through its central bore.
A weary traveler folds both arms and frowns beside an unmoving queue, with a heavy suitcase and tired posture.
A dairy cow stands side-on while its full udder is clearly visible beneath the hindquarters and a calf rests nearby.
A woman mourns a broken clay vase, bending toward the pieces with tears on her cheeks while a friend gently supports her shoulder.
A clothing fitter kneels beside a customer and carefully pins the hem of a half-finished coat during a fitting.
Thick icicles hang over a completely frozen pond while a bundled walker shivers beside frost-covered branches.
A coordinated outfit of jacket, waistcoat, shirt, tie and trousers is arranged together on a single standing dress form.
A child glimpses hidden party balloons through a partly open door while a surprised friend hastily tries to close it.
A grand stone entrance hall has towering columns, a sweeping staircase and one small visitor standing beneath the high ceiling.
A copper bowl shows many shallow hammer marks across its curved surface, with a rounded hammer resting beside it.
A teacher hands a small stack of illustrated worksheets to a student, while other students receive matching sheets at their desks.
A nervous performer grips the edge of a stage curtain and hesitates before stepping into the light, shoulders drawn inward.
A rabbit hops over a fallen branch, with both hind feet lifted and the body stretched forward above the ground.
A shapeless lump of soft clay slumps across a work board, with uneven edges and no clear geometric outline.
A child opens an elaborately wrapped gift box and finds it empty, lowering the shoulders in visible disappointment.
The rain has stopped above a wet path; a walker closes an umbrella beside still puddles and dripping leaves.
A musician laments a badly broken violin, holding the damaged instrument while a companion listens sympathetically.
A sturdy fenced animal pound contains two stray dogs, a water bowl and a keeper opening the enclosure gate.
Two historical naval recruiters firmly escort an unwilling man up a ship's gangplank while he pulls back toward the dock.
A fisher lifts a securely closed landing net containing one freshly captured fish above the side of a small boat.
An upholsterer stretches new blue fabric across a chair seat while the removed worn covering lies curled beside the stool.
A metalworker reheats old metal pieces in a crucible, with glowing molten metal beginning to flow from its tilted lip.
An investigator reexamines a set of muddy footprints with a magnifying glass beside an open notebook of simple sketches.
A repairer opens a watch case and studies its gears again under a bright work lamp, using a small inspection lens.
A female fish with a slackened abdomen swims above freshly released eggs attached to underwater plants immediately after spawning.
A traveler with a suitcase waits beside an airport gate while seated passengers watch an attendant checking the remaining empty seats.
A hand brings two blue counters together with three red counters into one shallow counting tray, forming one total group of five.
A demolition worker takes down a brick wall section by section, with a low pile of removed bricks and exposed timber nearby.
A chameleon extends its long tongue toward a small fly on a leaf, keeping its whole body and curled tail visible.
A small bus turns around on a broad curved track, with its front wheels sharply steered and tire marks tracing the bend.
A car leaves a main road along a narrow side road that branches toward a small cottage among trees.
A finger switches on a desk lamp; the pressed power button, glowing bulb and newly lit book are visible together.
A group of attendees fills the chairs of a small meeting room and faces a presenter standing at the front.
A child has just woken in bed and stretches both arms, with a ringing alarm clock and morning light beside the pillow.
A veterinarian gently examines a rabbit on a small animal-care table while a cat waits in a carrier nearby.
A head baker directs two assistants at a shared bakery bench, pointing to the next loaf while they listen attentively.
Two adult dogs tend a small litter of puppies in a sheltered kennel, with the puppies clustered closely beside their parents.
A cyclist who had fallen behind pedals hard and draws alongside the last rider in a small cycling group.
Guests in elegant formal clothes arrive at a candlelit dinner, adjusting ties and evening jackets near the entrance.
A thief makes a hurried getaway through an open garden gate, clutching a small sack while a pursuer rounds the corner.
A hurried adult walks past a child asking for attention, deliberately turning the face away despite the child's raised hand.
